WITH drive_stats AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', TIMEZONE('$__timezone', TIMEZONE('UTC', start_date))) AS mon,
    count(*) AS drives,
    sum(convert_km(distance::numeric, '$length_unit')) AS dist,
    sum(duration_min) / 60.0 AS hours,
    sum((start_${preferred_range}_range_km - end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * cars.efficiency) AS energy,
    sum(ascent) AS ascent
  FROM drives
  INNER JOIN cars ON drives.car_id = cars.id
  WHERE drives.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
    AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
charge_stats AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', TIMEZONE('$__timezone', TIMEZONE('UTC', start_date))) AS mon,
    count(*) AS charges,
    sum(charge_energy_added) AS added,
    sum(cost) AS cost
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  to_char(COALESCE(d.mon, c.mon), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
  d.drives AS "Drives",
  d.dist AS "Distance",
  d.hours AS "Hours Driven",
  d.energy AS "Energy Used",
  100 * d.energy / NULLIF(d.dist, 0) AS "kWh/100",
  d.ascent AS "Ascent (m)",
  c.charges AS "Charges",
  c.added AS "Energy Added",
  c.cost AS "Charging Cost",
  100 * c.cost / NULLIF(d.dist, 0) AS "Cost per 100"
FROM drive_stats d
FULL OUTER JOIN charge_stats c ON d.mon = c.mon
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
